name: 02 - UX Engineer v2 - With Conversation History

nodes.name: 🔷 UX Chat Input
nodes.notes:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📝 UX CHAT INTERFACE (User Iteration)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎯 PURPOSE:
Receives iterative design feedback from humans.
User says: "Make the button blue" and AI updates existing design.

📥 INPUT FORMAT:
{
  "message": "Make the button bigger and blue",
  "chat_id": "STORY-001" (groups conversation),
  "current_html": "<optional existing HTML>"
}

🔗 ENDPOINT:
POST /webhook/ux-chat

💡 WHEN TO USE:
After initial design exists, for refinements
Example: "Add a logo", "Change color", "Make responsive"

➡️ NEXT NODE: Merge Inputs

nodes.name: 🔶 PM Requirements Input
nodes.notes:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎯 PRODUCT MANAGER INPUT (New Design)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎯 PURPOSE:
Receives NEW design requirements from PM workflow.
Starts a fresh design conversation.

📥 INPUT FORMAT:
{
  "story_id": "STORY-123",
  "requirements": "Create a login page with...",
  "acceptance_criteria": [
    "Email validation",
    "Password toggle"
  ],
  "monday_item_id": "67890"
}

🔗 ENDPOINT:
POST /webhook/pm-to-ux

💡 WHEN TO USE:
For brand new screens/components
Called by Product Manager workflow or manual trigger

➡️ NEXT NODE: Merge Inputs
